description:
GoSearch connects your AI assistant to your organization's knowledge base. Ask a question and get answers pulled from the apps your team already uses, like Google Drive, Slack, Jira, Notion, and 100+ more, all in one place.

  Use it two ways:
  - Search across your connected apps to find the document, message, or ticket you need, with links back to the source.
  - Ask GoAI a question and get a written answer grounded in your organization's content, with citations so you can verify where it came from.

  GoSearch respects your existing permissions, so you only see results from content you already have access to.
